reason: The provision directly and materially supports the control objective by specifying the exact time limits for submitting an initial notification: within four hours of classifying an incident as major and no later than 24 hours after becoming aware of the incident.
evidence_excerpt: (a) for the initial report: as early as possible, but in any case, within four hours from the classification of the ICT-related incident as a major ICT-related incident and no later than 24 hours from the moment the financial entity has become aware of the ICT-related incident;
